//: Placeholder environment of the UI smoke builds (ops/ui-smoke.md). Nothing here is a secret or reaches a real service:
the browser RPC, PubSub and Supabase hosts are reserved .invalid names the tests answer themselves (ui-smoke/support),
the server RPC is a closed local port, and the server holds no Supabase service key. The default build is a localnet
build (any Supabase host is allowed there; a devnet build must name the real devnet project), with its own genesis hash.
The mainnet section repeats, for the server at run time, the placeholders scripts/ci/mainnet-build.sh builds with.
These are the app's whole environment: build.mjs and serve.mjs pass no other shell variable and no .env* file (hermetic-env.mjs).
